label: rare late-original/<DEL> feature in long sequences starting with y/c/e (unexplained)
explanation: Extremely sparse (0.009% of steps), weak (max 0.23). Fires almost only on the last 1-2 original tokens and the <DEL> step (to_go 0-1, plus the first original steps of the copy... none; copy phase ~0), mostly when L is 8-9, and is strongly enriched when the sequence starts with y, c or e (first_tok lift 6-10x) and somewhat when q appears early. Never fires at t<3 and essentially never during copy. However, the context (late original/<DEL>, first token y/c/e) holds about 1% precision: the large majority of such steps are silent, and no token or history condition we tried separated them. Best dev predicate: F1 0.05, mass recall 0.63 at precision 0.007. The firing condition is some sparse combination of the prefix that we could not identify.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=y (+4.41), orig0=e (+4.03), orig0=c (+3.90), orig1=y (+2.89), orig3=q (+2.81), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=i (+2.54). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.05), correct=1 (-4.12), next_out=- (-2.59), prev3_tok=- (-2.44).
